source_text: Gladius acutus et candens dupliciter torquet. Caveamus ne per hunc gladium transeamus. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: A sharp and glowing sword torments doubly. Let us beware lest we pass through this sword. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: A glowing blade cuts and burns at once. Pray we never must pass under it. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
